title: Sweet Apple Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this dessert combines the crunch of apples with the warmth of cinnamon. Perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together applesauce, cinnamon, and brown sugar.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add tortillas and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until slightly puffed.
Transfer tortillas to a baking sheet and spoon applesauce mixture onto each tortilla.
Top with chopped walnuts and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
